Name: Witchy Working Bookcase for Furniture Framework
Author: mintkupocream
Description:
There are many mods out there offering lovely custom chests, and many furniture packs that offer beautiful bookcases, but I have never found any that combined these two things together so that I may store my books on a bookcase. So, I have taken it upon myself to change that.

In this mod you will find one (1) singular piece of furniture. [b]It can be purchased at Robin's for a mere 2000 monies[/b]. Inside this furniture, you will find nothing. Put your books in it! The storage display is in a line list like you would find in a dresser, as that is how it works within [b]Furniture Framework([/b]required for this mod to work). Currently, there are no additional organizational tabs, as really only modded books could be sorted separately, and I felt it would be annoying for anyone that didn't have a particular set of modded books to have a useless tab on the side. While there is only the large, witchy bookcase included at the moment, I may make a more compact version to add in the future, and possibly some different color options. I also may make some bookcases in completely different styles if anyone is interested.

[b]Compatibility:[/b] 
Any book that is labeled internally as a book will work with this bookcase. If your modded books aren't going in, then they aren't labeled as a book. Let me know and I'll take a look to see about adding them.
